PDF Real-time Voxelization for Complex Models - GitHub Pages
Abstract In this paper we present an efficient voxelization algorithm for complex polygonal models by exploiting newest programmable graphics hardware. We first convert the model into three discrete voxel spaces according to its surface orientation.
